# AnNoor

> AnNoor: Adhan Prayer Quran is an Android app that helps Muslims with daily worship, finding nearby mosques and halal places, and discovering local job opportunities.

AnNoor brings prayer tools and local discovery features together in one mobile app.

## Main Features

- Prayer times and Adhan reminders.
- Sehri and Iftar times.
- Qibla direction finder.
- Quran and duas.
- Nearby mosque finder.
- Nearby halal restaurants, grocery stores, and businesses.
- Nearby jobs and local job opportunities.

## Official Website

- [AnNoor](https://annoor.app/): Official landing page with information about the app and its features.
